body.disclaimer: Provisional baseline system for emergency situational awareness. Not an official dispatch standard.

test_cases.label: Critical - Life Threat
test_cases.input_message: Water is rising rapidly near Aluva! 4 families are trapped on the terrace and need immediate boat rescue!

test_cases.label: High - Structural Ingress & Dam Burst
test_cases.input_message: The dam has burst and water is entering houses rapidly. Highway bridge collapsed.

test_cases.label: Moderate - Flood Warning & Advisory
test_cases.input_message: Flood alert issued for coastal zones. Flood warning in effect, river overflowing.

test_cases.label: Low - Emotional Support / Prayers
test_cases.input_message: Heartfelt prayers and support for everyone dealing with flood recovery in Kerala.

test_cases.label: Negated - Hazard Denied
test_cases.input_message: Situation is completely normal here, no flooding and no casualties reported.

test_cases.label: Historical - Retrospective
test_cases.input_message: Remembering the devastating flood in 2018 when many people died and bridges were destroyed.

test_cases.label: Non-Flood - Traffic Accident
test_cases.input_message: Car accident on main street near the vegetable market, police investigating.
